spec.name: m6_pig_squeal_3
spec.brief: Third pass: in the factory preset Q is not only sharper poles, it is a second vowel axis (Morph 0: 257/1763/2164 Hz becomes 491/1120/1524; Morph 1: the upper poles bunch upward to 2158-3661 Hz and F1 drops to 274). So the Q 1 corners get their own measured sources: an open a under Morph 0, a close i under Morph 1, then narrowed.
